methodology_limits: Stop exits always price AT the stop, even when the candle range extends far beyond it (no gap-through-stop slippage modeling; ambiguous bars resolve SL-first by documented convention, but clean gap bars share the same pricing).
No liquidation model: a margined position held through adverse moves is never liquidated in simulation; the venue would liquidate. Worst simulated case per trade is stop distance.
Both flatter tail risk vs live margined trading. Changing either would rewrite every frozen research number: documented as methodology, not patched speculatively.
